Timeline flight paywalls

Version 3, Nov 4: the trial for fliers within 24 h is hard and survives quitting the app, the pass is gone, the trial shows its price up front, and the soft flight paywall uses the same timeline. Built locally as superwall/paywalls/onboarding-near and previewed in the studio. Nothing is pushed and no campaign has changed.

Screens

Sample flight EWR → MCO. Prices are the real App Store products. Also checked: someone who has already had a trial sees the same page as “Subscribe · $39.99/year”, with no trial wording anywhere.

Quitting the app doesn't get past it

The app marks onboarding done only when the flow is dismissed. Before this change, quitting on the hard page restarted onboarding from the first question, where “I'll add it later” led to the closable Plans page. Now the trial page saves the flight in a user attribute (onboarding_hard_flight). On the next launch, the flow skips the questions and goes straight back to the same trial for the same flight, with a fresh forecast check. I tested it in the studio: reloading on the trial page lands on the trial again. It's paywall-only, with no app update.

  • Until when: until they subscribe or restore, or until 12 hours after departure. By then they've landed, “today / until you land” no longer fits, and the next launch runs the whole flow, which ends soft.
  • Gaps it can't close without an app update: a launch with no internet falls back to the app's built-in questions (soft), and so does deleting the flight before reopening. Both are rare.

Trial pricing (App Store 3.1.2)

  • The price billed ($39.99 per year) is the largest price on the page, on the plan card, with $3.33/month beside it.
  • The trial length and what happens after it appear three times: the “3 days free” badge, the timeline (“Sat, Nov 7 · Trial ends. $39.99/year unless you cancel before then.”) and the legal line (“Free for 3 days, then $39.99/year. Renews automatically. Cancel anytime in Settings.”).
  • The button reads “Start 3-day free trial”, so it doesn't promise “free” without the price nearby. Terms, Privacy and Restore are on the page.

What I need you to confirm

1. Where the timeline soft paywall goes. As built, it's only in the test paywall, so the test is “trial for fliers within 24 h + timeline for everyone else who adds a flight” against today's soft paywall. The other choice: put the timeline in onboarding-soft too, so the only difference between the arms is the trial.
2. Trial price: $39.99/year (bumpcast_pro_annual_3999_3d). The $49.99 product has no trial since Nov 3, and adding one back would put it on every paywall. One side effect: near fliers who've already had a trial are offered $39.99 instead of $49.99.
3. The two coverage lines are gone (“Detailed, hourly forecasts for US flights” / “Global outlook (beta)…”) to make room for the timeline. I can put a single line back on international flights only.

Known risk: the trial covers the very flight they came for. Last week 6 of 7 annual trials were cancelled, most within 3 minutes. The first real numbers arrive on day 3, when the trials end.

The failed payment (2EDBCD03), unchanged from version 1

StoreKit refused the purchase 34 ms after the tap, before the App Store sheet appeared. The same $49.99 product sold 2 hours earlier. 3 other users this week were blocked the same way (0.04–0.3 s “abandons”), which is 4 of the 17 people who tapped buy. The likely causes are Screen Time purchase limits, a child account, being signed out of Media & Purchases, or iOS 27.3. Proposed (needs your OK): a “check Screen Time” line on every paywall when this happens, and logging Apple's error code in the next app update.
